scenes.headline: How a 114B audio-video model wakes only 6B
scenes.sub: MAGI-2 Preview: two sparsities multiplied, and four residual streams.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Marbles! MAGI-2 Preview makes video and its sound together, from a hundred and fourteen billion parameters. A token wakes about six.

scenes.label: The trick
scenes.text: Two sparsities multiply: routed experts wake 72 of 3,072 slots, and a token is only one modality, so the other modalities' weights sleep.
scenes.say: The trick: two sparsities, multiplied. Experts are routed, and a token is only ever one modality, so the other modalities' weights sit idle.

scenes.title: Dense at the edges, sparse in the middle

steps.say: Forty layers. Video, audio and text enter through their own embedders, and leave through video and audio heads. Text is conditioning, not output.

steps.note: three private sets of weights, one per modality
steps.say: At both ends, two dense layers hold three private sets of weights, one per modality. A token only uses its own.
Through the middle, one shared attention mixes everything, and routed experts fire: six per head, twelve heads, seventy-two of three thousand seventy-two slots.

scenes.title: Active parameters per token, from the shapes
scenes.say: Routing alone takes a hundred and fourteen billion down to seven point seven one. One modality's weights take it to five point nine six.

steps.say: One more idea: hyper-connections. Instead of one residual stream, every layer carries four, and a learned four by four matrix mixes them.
Sinkhorn normalization makes that matrix doubly stochastic, so no stream quietly dominates, and a hand-written Triton kernel keeps the memory traffic down.

items.say: Generation takes two models. The preview stage denoises a small frame, five twelve by eight ninety-six, in a hundred steps.
A separate refiner, dense, with only local attention, upscales it in five. Neither is step-distilled yet, so that's where the time goes.

scenes.text: The sparsity is legible in the shapes: experts and modalities multiply to one active parameter in 19.
scenes.say: The lesson: routed experts and one-modality tokens multiply, and the whole budget is legible in the published shapes.

recap: Two sparsities multiply: about 6B of 114B awake
Private modality layers at the edges, experts between
scenes.say: To recap: two sparsities, private edges, and four mixed streams.
